title: thymus longiflorus subsp. funkii
intro: Thymus longiflorus subsp. funkii, commonly known as the Alpine Thyme, is a subspecies of the Thymus longiflorus plant, native to the mountainous regions of the Iberian Peninsula. This herb is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which provide various health benefits including the relief of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Thymus longiflorus subsp. funkii include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, expectorant, and antiseptic, making it useful for treating coughs, colds, and wounds. The plant's bioactive constituents include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its pharmacological properties and potential health benefits.
